title: Implement per-bit LLR distribution and statistics tools
description:
Implement analysis utilities that compute empirical per-bit LLR statistics and conditional distributions for each bit position within a symbol.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Analysis utilities can accumulate per-bit LLR samples or equivalent statistics for each bit position.
- [ ] The tooling can compute or export conditional statistics for $p(L_k \mid B_k = 0)$ and $p(L_k \mid B_k = 1)$.
- [ ] The output is usable for comparing different bit positions in Gray-QAM and other supported constellations.

## Notes

This task is about analysis tooling on top of the shared demapper outputs, not about creating a second demapper implementation.
